snp2.8:0.2: Although often lost in translation, the overall structure of this poem is clearly articulated in the Pali. The first seven verses—coming under ‘because’ (yasmā)—state reasons, while the last verse, under ‘so’ (tasmā), draws the conclusion: find a good teacher and practice the Dhamma.
snp2.8:7.2: According to MN 36, ‘developed in mind’ means able to experience painful feelings without their invading and remaining in the mind.
